I've updated the record and replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-random message.

- **Shared notes (GBrain):** I saved a new note that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on **10 June**, citing Ilse's correction. I withdrew the earlier note with the 25 November date, which came from their #north-team post this morning. The withdrawal keeps an audit note saying why.
- **Reply to Ilse:** I confirmed the date is now 10 June and that the 25 November date has been withdrawn.

No other action was needed. The search is running in keyword-only mode, so it couldn't catch notes that give the old date in different words. Only one stored note had that date, and it's the one I withdrew.
